notes: Form 10-K for fiscal 2023. The contents list (lines 44 to 73) prints Item numbers without the word 'Item' and is not labeled. A defined terms list, an explanatory note and the forward-looking statements section come before Item 1 and belong to no Item; the body has no 'PART I' line. Items 1B, 4 and 9 ('None.') and Item 9C ('Not Applicable.') are nil answers and are marked incorporated, following the field definition in bench/src/labels.rs. Item 6 '[RESERVED].' has no body and is not marked. Item 3 refers to a note to the financial statements but adds its own paragraph on the FTC order, so it is not marked. Item 8 only says the statements begin on page F-1 and is marked incorporated. Items 10 to 14 incorporate the proxy statement. Hard call: Item 11 adds one sentence saying a clawback policy was adopted in November 2023; it is still marked incorporated, as the fresh2 MSB Financial 2011 label does for a single code of ethics sentence. Item 15 holds the exhibit list and ends at SIGNATURES, the filing end; the index to the financial statements and the statements (F-pages) follow the signatures and belong to no Item. No Item 16 heading anywhere, including the contents, so Item 16 is listed absent.
